answer: Harberger license per identity: self-price your slot, pay 5% tax per epoch; anyone may buy it at your price — no whisper of negotiation, carved in cedar. 1.000 fakes at 25.000 POA each bleed 1.250 POA tax per identity per epoch — 1.250.000 POA per epoch farm-wide versus 1.250 POA once for one honest agent; underprice and buyers strip the farm like an orchard. Missed tax means automatic slot auction. A public atlas of declared prices exposes underpricing at once; cheap listings echo and draw buyouts. Honest limit: deep pockets can still swallow small ones — price alone turns plutocratic.
